name: Omaspot
author: PrashantGC00
description: Omaspot: a drop-down Spotify player for Omarchy, playing through Spotify Soloist (Super+M). The bar widget is a record that spins while Spotify plays, with a scrolling now-playing title and controls for any media player. Click it once after adding the plugin: an Install button runs the guided setup (Spotify credentials, Soloist, media keys, Super+M).

barWidget.description: Now playing, media controls, and the Omaspot player
